summary: XFLH Capital Corp (NYSE: XFLH/XFLHU/XFLHR), a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing a non-binding letter of intent, signed September 18, 2026, for a proposed business combination with Renogen Biolab Inc., a Canadian molecular-services provider. No price, exchange ratio, valuation, premium, or closing timeline was disclosed; only mutual reasonable-best-efforts undertakings to negotiate definitive agreements and conduct due diligence. No board recommendation or advisor is named. As a SPAC, XFLH faces a trustee-account/redemption overhang and a 12-month-plus deal clock. Watch for a definitive agreement, minimum-cash condition, and whether trust proceeds support the deal; arbitrage hinges on redemption levels and extension risk.
